race.comment: KENTUCKY DRIVE (10) missed in a photo finish over 1200m at Pinjarra when sitting handy throughout. She's had a few spins now, though she's going as well as ever and the rise in trip is a big tick. Will need some luck from a tricky barrier, but she can go one better in this suitable assignment. NONEOFYOURBUSINESS (11) disappointed last time out when getting a long way back and never featuring at Pinjarra. She's better than that though and stepping up in trip now is a good move. Likely to be in the second half of the field, but can make an impression with improvement on the cards. STATE OF BOOM (9) finished off nicely on debut for Pike in his only run last campaign. His recent trials coming into this were just fair, though the 1400m journey on resumption is a big tick. Can make a positive return. FORTUNATE SPIRIT (3) won't be far away if he runs to recent form. SAISOKU (5) won a trial coming into this and a solid return is expected.
